name: Neko no Goshujin-sama
source:
I went to the park on the day I moved into the town and found a dumped cat.....
The cat becomes a girl after bringing her home!!!
There is only one thing I would like to do with the innocent pussycat ......

[Edited From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ015667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
搬来这座小镇的那天，我去了公园，发现了一只被遗弃的猫……
把她带回家后，她竟然变成了女孩子！
面对这只天真无邪的小猫，我想做的事只有一件……

[编译自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ015667.html]DLsite English[/url]]
